svg.title: From Kenya to South Korea
svg.desc: A world map marking Kenya in East Africa and South Korea in East Asia, connected by a curved arrow pointing from Kenya to South Korea.
svg.metadata: Land geometry: world-atlas v2 land-110m, derived from public-domain Natural Earth 1:110 million data. https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/land-110m.json. Equirectangular projection; Antarctica omitted. Markers: Kenya 37.90 E, 0.02 N; South Korea 127.80 E, 36.20 N.
